title: Tamsin's scripted regret line as we left the region says 'Cinderhall's behind us, and I still don't know who lied about that collapse. That's mine to finish' — but she was standing right there when Preceptor Aldous confessed to signing the rotten-timber order, and she reacted to it by name ('Aldous's own truth, pulled plain...') and approved. The later line flatly contradicts a scene she already lived.
where: Coldpass South Stair, ambient party dialogue on arrival
